outcome: dual burden of childhood stunting and underweight
cohort: The study included 104,021 children under 5 years of age from India, obtained from the National Family Health Survey 5.
finding: The study revealed a significant positive association between childhood stunting (35.37% prevalence) and underweight (28.63% prevalence), with a dual burden prevalence of 19.45% among under 5 children in India, showing significant spatial heterogeneity.
mod_finding: Type of delivery was significantly associated with stunting (AOR = 1.12) and underweight (AOR = 1.19).
cross-section timing: Observations were taken for children who were under 5 years of age at the time of the National Family Health Survey 5.
